4115450.name: 影之刃零
4115450.desc: 由 S-GAME 自主研發與發行，採用 Unreal Engine 5 打造的暗黑武俠動作冒險遊戲。 你將化身為一名心臟重創、命僅餘六十六日的劍客，於刀光劍影與腥風血雨之間亡命逃亡，並一步步揭露籠罩整個武林的驚天陰謀。在這個失序、末法的江湖中，以身證道，以命尋心。

3558670.name: 《古墓奇兵：亞特蘭提斯遺跡》
3558670.desc: 體驗蘿拉·卡芙特首次歷險的震懾人心全新演繹，探索亞特蘭提斯的失落秘密，感受令人驚嘆的視覺效果、現代化的遊戲玩法及向原作精神致敬的全新驚喜。

movies.name: 古墓奇兵：亞特蘭提斯遺跡 發布日期預告片

2590240.name: 戰慄深隧2039
2590240.desc: 《戰慄深隧2039》 即將重新定義第一人稱射擊遊戲，由廣受好評的敘事遊戲團隊 4A Games 推出。深入末日後莫斯科的黑暗腹地，在攸關地鐵存亡的苦痛爭鬥中尋找出路。

4814120.name: 無限大
4814120.desc: 《無限大》是一款都市題材開放世界RPG。你將扮演不同角色，從重霄到新啓，穿梭於繁華街頭和隱秘角落，漫步在茶山古鎮與老城巷陌。在不同城市間探索，結識各具魅力的夥伴，建立自己的專屬團隊。

movies.name: ANANTA Launch Date Trailer | Global Release January 15th, 2027

4084710.name: Rayman Legends Retold
4084710.desc: 進入廣受好評的平台跳躍遊戲，踏上大膽的重述之旅，體驗全新視覺與再次講述的故事。支援單人或最多 4 人線下同樂——一起探索神祕的新世界、搖滾全新音樂關卡，並發掘更多驚喜！

3259780.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
3259780.desc: 如果「FINAL FANTASY」一直以點陣風格持續進化…… 本作是以此為概念，並以嶄新點陣風格描繪的「FINAL FANTASY」系列最新作品。 除了圍繞「水晶」展開的故事，以及回合制指令戰鬥與能力更換等系列經典要素外，亦收錄了豐富多樣的反覆遊玩內容。

3247750.name: Mycopunk — 真菌龐克
3247750.desc: 在這款高度自訂、以任務為核心的掠奪射擊遊戲中，與成群結隊的真菌外星人交戰，殺出一條血路。數百種精心製作的升級、四人合作模式，還有一名有趣的蜚蠊角色，令人愛不釋手！

1313230.name: Beautiful Light
1313230.desc: 《光芒行動》是 PvPvPvE 戰術撤離導向第一人稱射擊遊戲，總共 6 支隊伍，每支 3 名特戰兵，任務目標是前往充滿敵人的恐怖區域找到並帶走神器。你必須對抗其他特戰兵，以及由玩家操控的異象，但是請小心，因為一個不小心，你的性命和裝備就會有危險。

3486530.name: 愚者不滅（Stupid Never Dies）
3486530.desc: 在這款爆速成長動作 RPG 中，把最弱殭屍戴維培養成超強戰力！吃掉敵人、奪取能力並不斷變身，勇闖危險異世界地城，只為救活凍死的茱莉亞！

3335310.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
3335310.desc: 你的女兒遭人綁架了。在這部三部曲的最終章中，你將踏入一場噩夢，為了拯救她，必須在追捕你的威脅中生存下來，並透過「回溯認知」、「鏡像能力」以及「操控飛蛾」等能力，揭開「紅修女」的真相。這是一款融合義大利新黃色電影風格的現代生存恐怖遊戲，重現了經典生存恐怖遊戲的精髓。

movies.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy - Release Date Trailer
Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy - Gameplay Trailer

4694770.name: HELLBENT
4694770.desc: HELLBENT is a souls like inspired game where you play as a knight of the Heavenly Order tasked with defeating a lord of hell who resides in purgatory.

4491130.name: Kings Call 2
4491130.desc: 在《Kings Call 2》這款遊戲中，你將化身銀鷺嶺領主！收集卡牌召喚強大生物、釋放絢麗法術、擊敗兇猛怪物，穿越區域守護自己的王國。遊戲支援自由構建專屬卡組，展開深度策略對戰，還能結交盟友團隊協作，同時提供快速對局與自由交易的樂趣。四大職業各展神通：法師擅長範圍傷害與控制敵軍，牧師以治療和聖光守護盟友，遊俠精準打擊並掌控節奏，戰士則提升團隊輸出。卡牌品質從白到金，士兵分普通與精英，準備值歸零即可部署。來吧，挑戰智力與勇氣的極限，守護你的王國！

5099260.name: Desktop Monsters
5099260.desc: Turn your desktop into a digital battlefield. Build 5 attack towers and a Firewall Barrier, face 24 threats across 3 battlefields, conquer a 24-wave campaign and 7 challenges, or survive Endless. Local LAN multiplayer adds sabotage, virus deployment and Retaliation Mode.

5402800.name: Argot's Laboratory Demo
5402800.desc: Argot's Laboratory (Demo) is a 1-bit science simulator that puts you in charge of a high tech science lab! Modify, inspect, and evolve strange creatures, all while trying to not to lose your job... Can you complete the genetic tree before time runs out or will your boss finally snap?

5466950.name: Highrise Window Washer Demo
5466950.desc: This is a demo of the first side of the building.

5447730.name: Voiceless Demo
5447730.desc: The first French POV slasher film in FMV, shot to keep you on the edge of your seat Voiceless is an interactive live-action slasher film designed as a faux single take: every decision is made in real time.

5267100.name: Astro Fighters 3 Demo
5267100.desc: 外星人回來了。完整體驗《ASTRO FIGHTERS 3》的前兩個關卡，解鎖6艘強大的玩家戰機和70張強化卡，並挑戰程序生成的Gauntlet模式，體驗充滿動作的街機彈幕射擊遊戲。

fullgame.name: The Labyrinth At The End Of Time

4858580.name: The Labyrinth At The End Of Time Demo

5382150.name: PropAlive Demo
5382150.desc: PropAlive is a tense 1v4 asymmetrical PROPHUNT game where one player becomes an ancient demon, while the others are survivors who can disguise themselves as objects and use unique abilities. Hide. Trick. Survive. Or Hunt.

5393850.name: TRACE Demo
5393850.desc: TRACE is a rhythm game combining arcade-style elements with the precision and competitiveness of PC rhythm games. Follow the music and experience the full energy of an arcade in the comfort of your own home!

5286800.name: Love: Fall in Death Demo
5286800.desc: 當你在酒吧裡試圖吸引 Aishil 時，將會面對夜晚的黑暗面。 一場看似無害的調情，卻演變成一段出乎意料的故事。 你的選擇、時機，以及一次擲骰，都可能把這段浪漫帶向愛情……或毀滅。

5462350.name: Skull & Tail: Demo
5462350.desc: Hey! Welcome to the demo of Skull & TailThe game is still in development, so things might change! Give it a try, have fun, and let me know what you think. Your feedback means a lot!

5329410.name: Shark Tales: Reef Rogues
5329410.desc: Small fins. Big trouble. Battle underwater swarms solo, in four-player local co-op or Steam online co-op. Evolve oddball weapons, hunt buried stories and outfit a crew that looks as strange as it fights.

5164830.name: Futa Fitness 🤸‍♀️
5164830.desc: Kyla is a hot blonde chick, the kind guys stare at in the gym. But what has her so captivated is her idol, Mara, and Mara’s exposed futa cock! If only she could get her hands – and mouth! – on that fine thick meat! Mara’s a serious gym fiend, but can Kyla convince her to try another type of workout?

5255040.name: The Book
5255040.desc: No accounts, no stores, no distractions. Bring the books you already own — EPUB, PDF, TXT, HTML, CBZ, CBR and image folders — and read them as 3D books.

4835610.name: Cielvia-Inherited By Defeat-
4835610.desc: Turn defeat into power. Gain new abilities by falling to your enemies, grow stronger with every attempt, and overcome relentless trials in this survivors-like action game. Switch between Light and Dark forms to create your own unique combat style.

5293210.name: ROGRID
5293210.desc: 當踩地雷遇上Roguelike。根據線索推理隱藏的格子，在怪物與陷阱之間尋找寶藏。搭配職業、技能與神器，用自己的策略突破地城。

movies.name: ROGRID — Gameplay Trailer 2026 (zh-TW · 繁體中文)
ROGRID — Gameplay Trailer (zh-TW · 繁體中文)

5308440.name: Tiny Desktop Fishing
5308440.desc: 《微型桌面钓鱼》是一款轻松治愈的像素风桌宠钓鱼小游戏。在秋日田园的湖畔，开启悠闲垂钓时光。你可以随时打开桌面，抛竿、等鱼咬钩，收集各式各样的小鱼，享受不被打扰的慢节奏休闲体验。无需重度操作，随时开玩，适合碎片化时间放松。

5359760.name: The Harbour Between Us
5359760.desc: 一款免費的溫馨桌面釣魚遊戲，訴說小小港灣裡一段從未老去的愛情。釣魚、逛黃昏市集、摸摸貓咪，再循著未曾寄出的情書，幫助兩位年邁的戀人重新相聚。

4714620.name: Dynamite Blue
4714620.desc: 以角色與劇情為核心的2.5D回合制RPG。在天空、街道與暗影交織的賽博龐克都市維爾海文，與60多名各懷故事的英雄同行。《Exos Heroes》原班團隊新作。

top.text: AI art, english translation is close to gibberish, there's no option menu to change the game to fullscreen mode or reduce volume. Combat is super simple with only basic attack and skill as options.

5340080.name: CHAMBER: ATOM BREAKER INC
5340080.desc: A reactor made of breakable pixels. Stir the atoms with your hand, fuse them up the ladder, and chew through the chamber wall layer by layer until the fuel runs out. The playing field is what you spend.

4206250.name: 高山之旅
4206250.desc: 高山，慢慢爬。和登山小貓一起，走向七大洲的 150 座真實山峰。挑選路線、備好補給，照顧沿途的體力與心情，登上山頂，再平安歸來。翻開動物圖鑑，發現山友留下的藏寶，或把旅程留在桌面一角，讓小貓陪你度過日常。

5328220.name: Mall Corp
5328220.desc: John is an ordinary security guard at a shopping mall who has been working there for 40 years. It was supposed to be just another routine shift. But this night hits different.

4668060.name: Reshine Demo
4668060.desc: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

5197920.name: 概率工坊 Demo
5197920.desc: 《機率工坊》是一款以彩券為題材的經營模擬遊戲：你不是下注的人，而是制定規則的人。從零設計一個彩種——號碼怎麼選、票價訂多少、設幾個獎級、獎金如何分配，把每一期收入分進獎池、加盟商佣金、公益金與利潤，每一個決定都由你做出。然後讓它運轉 60 期：銷量隨規則起伏，加盟商隨市場前景與實際收益來去，而彩迷們的人生，會因中獎或一次次「差一點」走向截然不同的方向。試玩版提供完整 60 期經營週期，期末可檢視經營總結與城市帳本；規則由你制定，機率從不說謊。

5359970.name: 爪爪谋略 Demo
5359970.desc: Paw and Plot is a lighthearted, hex-based turn-based strategy game. Players follow Latte, a kitten separated from his family, who meets Cantheon—a fallen feline deity hunted by wild cats. By helping Cantheon regain his power, Latte embarks on an adventure to reunite with his family.

4621970.name: Loop Dungeon - Incremental
4621970.desc: 帶領英雄小隊穿梭於無盡的地下城循環之中。在這款不斷成長的漸進式（Incremental）冒險遊戲中，收集戰利品、解鎖永久升級，並在邁向更深層地下城的過程中建立強大的協同效應。

4693350.name: I can offer your Flowers Demo
4693350.desc: ‘To propose to my boyfriend... what flowers would you recommend?’ Arrange bouquets in this cozy puzzly game! Discover flowers, meet new people, and become the Atrium Botanique community center florist !

5404520.name: Dragon Heist Demo
5404520.desc: A co-op heist game for up to 4 players: sneak into a sleeping dragon's lair, loot its gold, steal its egg and escape through the portal together, without making a sound.

4331890.name: GetHigh.EXE
4331890.desc: 在跑酷障礙賽道上奔跑跳躍，一路攀登至山頂，掌握精準且節奏明快的街機式挑戰。

top.text: I beat this game. Ive gotten used to Roblox's obby games, so I can beat every single obstacle in this game in less than 2 hours :)

6850.name: Hitman 2: Silent Assassin
6850.desc: Enter the realm of a retired assassin, forced back into action by treason. You may be a hired killer but you still have a sense of loyalty and justice. Visit the dark recesses of a world corrupted by crime, greed, degradation and dishonor. And a past that catches up with you.

top.text:

6860.name: Hitman: Blood Money

When assassins from Agent 47's contract agency, The ICA, are eliminated in a series of hits, it seems a larger, more powerful agency has entered the fray. Sensing he may be a target, 47 travels to America, and prepares to make a killing.

628800.name: Super Hydorah
628800.desc: 超級宇宙巡航機是非線性的水準射擊，旨在提供具有挑戰性的體驗， 在經典元素的基礎上增加智慧性和豐富性。 無論是獨自還是和你的朋友一起， 面對Meroptians登陸蘭斯三角洲的的威脅，都是緊張而愉悅的時光。

274520.desc: 《陰暗森林》—以全新視角詮釋生存恐怖。白天，在內容豐富、瞬息萬變的開放世界中探索並搜刮資源；夜晚，躲進藏身處設法死守，祈禱黎明盡速到來。

244160.name: Homeworld Remastered Collection
244160.desc: Experience the epic space strategy games that redefined the RTS genre. Control your fleet and build an armada across more than 30 single-player missions. Choose unit types, fleet formations and flight tactics for each strategic situation.

2103680.name: Mediterranea Inferno
2103680.desc: Explore the inner demons of three childhood friends on a summer retreat. Unearth secrets, fears and obsessions as you help them reconnect and rediscover themselves. A mature and treacherous visual novel from the creator of Milky Way Prince – The Vampire Star.

284160.name: BeamNG.drive
284160.desc: 一款能執行任何操作的動態軟體物理效果車輛模擬器。

top.text: I love it,the crash,phy,all....
非常擬真 但遊戲性普通
物理超讚

4889610.name: Ice Cream Hero
4889610.desc: Ice Cream Hero is a sweet tower defense challenge for one to four players. Team up with friends or play solo as Nilla, a brave little ice cream hero defending his land’s precious Sprinkle Bank from hungry silverware, chaotic waves, and big bad bosses.

5255590.name: Parry X Break
5255590.desc: Designed for high replay value and quick restarts, Parry X Break is a fast paced spin on the brick breaker genre where the ball goes faster every time you parry it. Parrying speeds up the ball, raises your point multiplier, and levels up your ball so you can break locked bricks.

5296420.name: GemLoop
5296420.desc: GemLoop is a match-3 incremental game featuring continuous progression through earning money and unlocking skills in an extensive skill tree.

4381180.name: Coin Harvest
4381180.desc: 機械臂把源源不絕傾瀉到高台上的硬幣掃下邊緣。解鎖島嶼、征服六個領域、飛升收集水晶，這款放置遊戲會在你工作或玩遊戲時待在桌面上。

top.text: Chilling game

5356880.name: FORGEFIELD
5356880.desc: Live wallpapers and screensavers for Windows, featuring nine animated worlds rendered in real time. Explore black holes, auroras and glowing embers. Choose a world, adjust its visual settings, and enjoy it on your desktop or in fullscreen.

5208900.name: Homegrown: Sports Agent Empire
5208900.desc: Run a sports agency, not a team. Recruit stars across four leagues, negotiate under real salary-cap rules, survive scandals and holdouts, then retire to an interactive career review and post your score to the monthly global leaderboard. Premium, no microtransactions.

movies.name: Homegrown: Sports Agent Empire — Launch Trailer

4769150.name: Anomaly Jobs : Death Row
4769150.desc: Same Path again and again. Everything looks familiar, until it does not. Some Anomalies hide in plain sight. Some are hard to spot. Find them, then take the correct exit. Every wrong choice lets the night draw closer.

4633060.name: Pareidolia
4633060.desc: Confront the games your own mind plays on you deep within a remote forest. Step out of your tent, set up your cameras, and gather clues. Remember: those silhouettes you see in the shadows might not just be your paranoia. The darkest corner of your mind is your deadliest enemy.

2641800.name: Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts
2641800.desc: In this sequel of the LGBT visual novel Reborn a Zombie, Dawn, a trans girl turned zombie, now has to confront her past. However, the Demon King is approaching and his presence will change everything.

movies.name: Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts trailer

5286740.name: AimZen
5286740.desc: AimZen is a minimalist first-person aim trainer with stackable hotkey-activated modifiers, built to sharpen precision, reaction speed, and muscle memory.

5332060.name: It'll Hold
5332060.desc: Play poker hands to build a tower of cards, one floor at a time. Each hand lays a floor piece on the plot. Stack matching suits straight up to grow your multiplier, beat every floor's target and hire a crew on your coffee break. Miss a target and the lot comes down.

4185740.name: アオノアーティファクト+
4185740.desc: "Blue Artifact" is a side-scrolling action game where Fran, a girl awakened deep underground in a research facility, uses magic to escape. Collect “treasures” within the facility to uncover the secrets of the research lab.

movies.name: アオノアーティファクト+Official Trailer

3536520.name: Warding Witches
3536520.desc: Warding Witches offers a classic, unapologetic bullet hell shoot ‘em up challenge while also putting defense into players’ hands. Experience an adrenaline-filled flow alternating between attacking, defending and dodging, amplified by an intuitive scoring system that weaves into gameplay seamlessly.

5336590.name: Howling Woods
5336590.desc: A cozy Halloween town builder. Lay out paths and plots in a clearing in the woods and the town takes care of the rest: crooked houses go up, curio shops open, and goblins, ghosts and witches move in. The spookier your town gets, the grander it grows. Nothing costs a thing. Every day is Halloween!

top.text: If you enjoy peaceful sandbox games and Halloween aesthetics then you will likely enjoy this game. I was apprehensive about the developers use of AI, and by all means that can be criticized, but the game does look and fu
It's chill and very low-demand, nothing to really manage other than fright. It looks nice, overall. I'm struggling with lag as things progress, though.

1024950.desc: Starship Horizons is a multi-player experience allowing 2-6 players commanding a Starship as the bridge officers in the roles of Captain, Flight, Tactical, Science, Operations, and Engineering.

top.text: fun group game

5126160.name: Tall Orders
5126160.desc: Tall Orders is a co-op platforming game where you and a friend play as small gnomes tending to a wizard's potion shop for the day. Work together to overcome your size, find the right ingredients, and brew potions. But beware, handling the ingredients may cause strange side effects!

5262270.desc: Fight tactical card duels across three rows and three rounds. Infect enemy cards with parasites, turn the weather into a weapon, and master the art of the well-timed pass. Every card hand-crafted, every duel a puzzle. Just you, the board, and one more match.

3535920.name: Mike goes on hike Demo
3535920.desc: 告別城市，展開一場第一人稱健行冒險。探索山間步道、拍攝照片，將旅途中的回憶填滿麥克的旅行日誌——從刺激的滑索體驗，到營火旁的寧靜夜晚。

4919380.desc: A chaotic free-for-all heist game where you backstab your friends for the biggest payout. Trigger fire alarms, tase your rivals, and steal their loot right out of their hands. Race to the getaway van before the cops arrive, because until you extract, nothing you stole is truly yours.

5460790.name: Frogball Demo
5460790.desc: Classic 90's GameBoy style Pinball... this time with frogs! Compete against your friends and the world for the highest scores on 8 unique, interlinked pinball tables. It's fast, fun and impossible to put down!

5350040.desc: A free 1v1 collectible card game with a mean sense of humour. Build a 30-card deck from six kinds of mana, climb the ranked ladder, draft from sealed packs and fight in weekly tournaments.

2089530.name: Parawyrm
2089530.desc: Parawyrm is a unique horror experience like no other where enemies and hazards will challenge your very senses. Explore a seamless world with collectables to find and secrets to uncover...

17710.name: Nuclear Dawn
17710.desc: Explore war-torn post-apocalyptic landscapes and take fight against enemies using various weapons in this FPS/RTS hybrid.

top.text:
Nuclear Dawn 中文名為 核子黎明
是一個FPS的戰略型遊戲
擁有類似於戰地風雲系列的指揮官

這遊戲其實是有部分中文化的，不過在商店頁面並沒有寫到

玩家分有4種兵種，並沒有太多種類的武器
但也因此更加強調技術性的重要，而不是依靠強勢裝備

最有特色的部分應該是指揮官
玩家佔領據點以獲取積分，而指揮官利用這些積分可以去興建大型機具
機具有 重生點、機槍塔、補給站、發電機、中繼站 ...等

遊戲獲勝關鍵為攻破對方主堡，而玩家

目前這遊戲只有一種模式

不過我還是非常推薦一定要玩玩看


設計上HUD以及武器都非常"未來" 還有因為不同職業會有特殊的武器給你用


如果下場厭煩了 還可以選擇當指揮官過過癮



剛開始玩或許不覺怎樣 不過到後來會越玩越起勁


此遊戲有等級系統....等級高沒啥用只是凸顯你玩多久罷了

現在仍有很多人玩,我隨意連都可以.
There are still lots of persons to play this game.

301840.name: City of Brass
301840.desc: 資深《生化奇兵》開發人員傾力打造，以阿拉伯之夜為藍本的第一人稱冒險動作遊戲。

top.text:
風格獨特的rogue like遊戲，但美中不足的是變化性不夠多
而且到後期的商店跟賭博獎勵通常是已裝備的武器或道具，除了浪費錢就沒什麼太大的作用
還有最終boss難到(跟前面比起來)不看攻略根本不知道正確的打法
(內含最終boss攻略暴雷，請謹慎食用)
 要站在精靈兩側有圖案的地板上，用鞭子纏住精靈的雙手，最後用鞭子攻擊精靈的頭部才能消滅

一共13關 死掉一切重來 祝福全開不難
就陷阱比較煩 大多傷害來自陷阱
全開負荷成就比較有挑戰性
多利用買保險 存道具<地圖 疑惑>
下一輪會簡單許多 
運氣好點 遇到解除陷阱 整個難度減半

關卡從第一關到最後共13關，死掉就要從頭來。又或浪費願望進入儲存點。
一開始覺得很麻煩。當發現角色的武器、鞭子以及BUFF變多又更實用時，就可以帶著娛樂的心態逛完整座城市。
中東風格的外觀和怪物，多樣的陷阱、被動技能的豐富性。不錯可以敗下去！

397190.name: Sengoku Jidai: Shadow of the Shogun
397190.desc: Sengoku Jidai: Shadow of the Shogun is a turn-based tactical and strategic game set during the Sengoku era; primarily focusing on the Japanese Warring States period and Japanese Invasion of Korea.

top.text:
最近重玩這款，覺得蠻可惜的。這系列我比較喜歡隔壁的P&S。因爲那款的混合兵種比較細膩一些。
FOG規則我基本上很喜歡，因爲他抽象的描寫了大部分古代會戰的常識。
他最大缺點就是他只重視會戰，所以很多古代的那種長達數日的大戰術是沒有辦法在那個系統展現的。
而很多歷史上很强的軍隊，其實擅長的是那種大戰術機動，而非單純的一日内定勝負的大會戰。
不過他的會戰邏輯真的比大部分的電腦游戲好太多了，所以變成電腦上少數“能玩”的游戲。

不過這款的問題真
游戏模式相当不错，剧本丰富度也很高，值得推荐。希望出中文啊！
沒有漢化不能忍，但是戰術設定真是細緻而真實，很好地反映了冷熱兵器交替時代的戰術特色（唯一的缺點似乎就是騎兵機動力偏低了，我很多次騎兵被槍陣追上且背攻？？？）

compare.en: Sengoku Jidai: Shadow of the Shogun

dlc.name: Sengoku Jidai – Colonies and Conquest Army Book pdf
Sengoku Jidai – Empires of the Dragon Army Book pdf
Sengoku Jidai – Field of Glory Renaissance Core Rules pdf
Sengoku Jidai – Genko Campaign (2nd Mongol Invasion of Japan 1281)
Sengoku Jidai – Bjeongja Horan Campaign (2nd Manchu Invasion of Korea 1636)

975470.name: Silver Chains
975470.desc: Silver Chains is a first-person horror game with a strong emphasis on story and exploration. Search for clues within an old abandoned manor to unravel the truth about the terrible events which have happened.

top.text:
遊戲故事流程不長，
整體遊玩下來，給人的感覺像是披著恐怖遊戲外皮的解謎遊戲。
想嘗試接觸恐怖遊戲的新朋友倒是可以入手試試水溫！

這是壹款第壹人稱恐怖遊戲，在遊戲中玩家將扮演壹位失去了自己記憶的主角，在壹棟近似迷宮的宅子裏面探索發現關於這個宅子的所有秘密。但是當玩家進行到壹定階段的時候，才會恍然大悟，明白整個故事的劇情。遊戲是以UE4引擎制作，優化並不是特別好，在壹部分場景會遇到經常性的掉幀。整個遊戲的環境塑造的非常棒，如果妳是壹個愛好恐怖遊戲的玩家，那麽壹定要嘗試壹下這款遊戲。

點擊加入趣遊鑒賞組，一同探索遊戲的樂趣~
歡迎關註趣遊鑒賞家，查看更多趣味性評測。

劇情有點薄弱,開頭跟結尾也是隨便沒有交代。

驚嚇點不多,解謎的線索都很明顯不會卡關，

遊玩的氣氛還不錯,就是鬼的模組有點糟糕!

鬼媽媽就固定出現那6次，反而最後的boos戰有一點刺激感。

277700.name: On Rusty Trails
277700.desc: 在這個風馳電掣的跳躍遊戲裏，隨機應變，適者生存就是最高綱領。 時刻准備著，以秒殺的速度轉變你的陣營。 無論是高台厚榭還是萬丈深淵，保存點還是致命陷阱——即使在一躍之間，一切都變化莫測。。。

movies.name: On Rusty Trails - Release Trailer (Traditional Chinese)

top.text:
這很完整的呈現了一個世界，很難得可以看到這樣的遊戲
從場景、故事到能力，裡頭的一切都在講述種族嚴重的對立
只不過角色們都小小的再加上設計上也很可愛，一點也不嚴肅
實在很喜歡主角以不同身分經過同一群人的反應，會看到愛心或是中指www

看起來充滿工業化和廢墟的場景中，時不時會出現大型看板
畫面強制拉遠讓小小的主角瞬間產生強大的對比
除了瞭解衝突到什麼地步(越來越激進)、欣賞有點幽默的設計
也給我一種，啊啊，我們身為主角也是小小的一份子的感

游戲體驗不好，大概玩2小時之後就只是想破關而已
越後面越多要求操作的，這沒關係，但是在你一陣操作之後來到的新地點，卻只有不到一秒的時間讓你切換紅藍
這種設計太多了，實在不有趣
幸好有很多記錄點，不然我應該是不會玩到破關
然後使用記錄點的話會影響成就，所以我就放棄成就了~
我就衝著這個醜到爆的icon給負評，拜託把那坨不知道是光明會還是翔的桌面圖示改掉好嗎？

301860.name: Submerged
301860.desc: 淹沒之城是第三人稱無戰鬥遊戲，在其中你可以探索神秘的汪洋城市，在偌大的戶外環境中發現荒涼之美。你成為米古的角色，一個年輕女孩帶著她受傷的弟弟，乘著他們的小漁船來到這個城市。用船到處探索汪洋城市，登上沉沒的建築物，用望遠鏡看清城市，尋找可以拯救弟弟的補給品。用自己的步調探索城市時，你碰上了多采多姿、繁茂生長的棲息地，而發現隱藏的物品慢慢拼湊出破碎世界還有一個破碎家庭的故事。

top.text: 如果不执着全成就纯粹的享受风景和音乐是不错的体验。后期略枯燥重复，相当于把古墓丽影里的攀爬单独制作了一个游戏。站在高处先用望远镜各个角度看一遍能找到大部分收集内容。我为了全成就开全地图花了将近十小时，整个后期有点折磨人，只为了圆满结束游戏。10分的话，我给7分。玩法简单轻松没压力。想给个中评价，没有的话那就给个推荐吧。

1125910.name: Crowns and Pawns: Kingdom of Deceit
1125910.desc: 古老的傳說揭開了現實的面紗, 帶來了一場奇妙的冒險. 背起你的行囊, 穿越現代歐洲, 揭開一段塵封往事, 品味一位從未被加冕過的國王的辛酸秘史.

top.text: Sorry I can't recommend this game, the motorcycle level is really annoying, even though I tried countless times it still failed, and has nothing to do with the game

It gets hard to bear whenever the character walk s l o w l y. Every time she leaves the library or walks towards a task. She walks s l o w l y, s o   s l o w   y o u   w i s h   y o u   n e v e r   b o u g h t   t h e

Super fun game, would recommend! I love checking every nook and cranny to find secrets and extra loot. Classic boomer shooter that really gets you moving quickly around levels to get better angles on enemies, 10/10 <3

5369560.desc: The original soundtrack of Nest Rivals, featuring 12 instrumental tracks from the game’s living, changing world.

4314060.name: PuzzMao〜Puzzle and Magical Overlord〜
4314060.desc: Heartwarming Fantasy × Falling-Block Puzzle Game PuzzMao～Puzzle and Magical Overlord～ is a falling-block puzzle game set in a fantasy world where you battle for the throne of Demon Lord! Defeat the advancing enemies with simple rules and exhilarating puzzles!

5409680.name: Echo Pandemic Demo
5409680.desc: Earth needs antibodies. You are one of them. Play as a bat who hunts by echolocation, infects alien invaders with engineered diseases, and stays one mutation ahead in a desperate biological war for the planet.

5357950.name: Grind or Die
5357950.desc: Grind or Die is an endless, top-down arena survival game packed with demonic hordes, brutal bosses, randomized upgrades, and character-specific powers. Build your warrior, time your dashes, and fight through waves that grow increasingly unforgiving.

4944840.name: 瘋狂喵喵拼圖
4944840.desc: 剛下班回到家，迎接你的卻是無盡的災難？ 《瘋狂喵喵拼圖》是一款結合貓咪搗亂與俄羅斯方塊的休閒益智遊戲。 找到缺失的拼圖，看看這幾隻調皮搗蛋的貓咪到底對你的家做了什麼好事！

3839910.name: Only Fans
3839910.desc: <Only Fans>是一款隱藏物件狩獵遊戲，你將在滿是風扇的戒色康復中心裡尋找看起來好像胸部和屁股等的物體。

1347780.name: Freedom Fighters
1347780.desc: Freedom Fighters is an intense third-person action game set in an alternate history New York during the invasion of a foreign superpower. Take on the role of Chris Stone, a hard-working plumber, and rise through the ranks of the resistance to prove yourself as a charismatic leader.

1045720.name: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters
1045720.desc: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters is a Korean survival horror-adventure. Venture from your deserted school to survive the horrors of the night. Explore the surrounding Sehwa district and uncover the shadow realm's dark secrets. Use everything at your disposal to avoid a demoness hellbent on killing you!

movies.name: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters - Live Action

8870.name: 生化奇兵：無限之城 完全版
8870.desc: Indebted to the wrong people, with his life on the line, veteran of the U.S. Cavalry and now hired gun, Booker DeWitt has only one opportunity to wipe his slate clean. He must rescue Elizabeth, a mysterious girl imprisoned since childhood and locked up in the flying city of Columbia.

1536620.name: 故障星系 Galactic Glitch
1536620.desc: 《故障星系》是一款以物理為核心的Roguelike射擊遊戲！抓起巨石，接住導彈，撕裂你的敵人——然後將它們作為彈藥使用！獲取新能力，解鎖新路徑，發掘秘密。從豐富的武器和能力中打造你的專屬構建，打破模擬世界的束縛！

movies.name: Galactic Glitch - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer

67370.name: The Darkness II
67370.desc: An intense first person shooter that delivers a twisted and gripping narrative of tragedy, modern crime drama, and supernatural horror.

251430.name: The Inner World
251430.desc: The Inner World – A 2D-Point’n’Click Adventure Together with the help of the mysterious thief Laura, his best intentions and no clue whatsoever, Robert sets off on his adventure to discover the secret of the wind's disappearance. Will the young adventurer be able to save his world?

1186640.name: 南瓜杰克
1186640.desc: Pumpkin Jack is a Spooky Scary 3D platformer in which you embody Jack, the Mythical Pumpkin Lord! Dive into an Epic Adventure through otherworldly landscapes and help the Evil annihilate the Good!

1577120.name: 獵逃驚魂
1577120.desc: 在夏令營的最後一晚，隨著夜幕逐漸低垂，九名年輕的輔導員發現自己陷入了充滿未知變數的恐怖夜晚。除了雙手滿是鮮血的當地人和恐怖怪物的追殺，你還必須做出各種意想不到的艱難選擇，才能讓這群年輕人逃出生天。

movies.name: The Quarry - Accolades - EN No Rating
The Quarry - Launch Day - EN No Rating

206440.name: To the Moon
206440.desc: 这是一个讲述两个医生借由改变记忆为弥留之际的人们完成他们人生最后愿望的故事。

1172650.name: INDUSTRIA
1172650.desc: INDUSTRIA是一款經典的第一人稱射擊遊戲，它將你帶入一個冷戰結束前不久幾乎被遺忘的平行宇宙。在一個無情的蒸汽朋克世界，你需要尋找失踪的同事，並破譯提出了重大道德問題的黑暗過去。

1063660.name: Bendy and the Dark Revival
1063660.desc: Bendy and the Dark Revival® is a first-person survival horror game set in the creepiest cartoon studio to ever exist. Discover the truth. Escape the studio. Above all, fear the Ink Demon…and survive.

movies.name: Bendy and the Dark Revival - Gameplay Trailer
Bendy and the Dark Revival - Official Trailer

1141120.name: Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood
1141120.desc: 又是格羅姆王國新的一天。陽光從地平線一路延伸，一個枝繁葉茂、生機盎然的世界漸漸浮現，這裡充滿著魔法、美麗和古老文化留下的寶物。這片土地是矮人族的家園，但並不只有他們，還有七女巫、鐵皮騎士、會說話的野獸、可怕的怪物和商隊。

movies.name: Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood - March 2021
Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood | Teaser Short "Riddles"

compare.en: Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood

1089830.name: Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 3
1089830.desc: 再曆 2019 賽季，在生涯模式中加入官方隊伍！ 在全新的多人遊戲體驗及其多樣新模式中，盡享趣味；與好友一道共用全新線上復合場地；以不加限制的賽道編輯器盡顯您的無限創意。

compare.en: Monster Energy Supercross - The Official Videogame 3

57300.name: Amnesia: The Dark Descent
57300.desc: Amnesia: The Dark Descent, a first person survival horror. A game about immersion, discovery and living through a nightmare. An experience that will chill you to the core.

345660.name: RIDE
345660.desc: Bikes from the world's most beloved motorcycle manufacturers, breathtaking races, and a round-the-world trip taking in 15 different locations, all this and more in the new videogame: RIDE.

282140.name: SOMA
282140.desc: From the creators of Amnesia: The Dark Descent comes SOMA, a sci-fi horror game set below the waves of the Atlantic ocean. Struggle to survive a hostile world that will make you question your very existence.

1602080.name: Soulstice
1602080.desc: 探索充滿著各種隱藏秘密的黑暗世界，精通各種戰鬥系統，利用Briar 和 Lute的雙重力量在青春奇幻故事中應對快節奏的行動，惡貫滿盈的敵人和令人窒息的 Boss 戰。

337340.name: Finding Paradise
337340.desc: Two doctors traverse backwards through a dying man's memories to fulfill his last wish. This is To the Moon's standalone sequel, but can also be played first.

1614270.name: Submerged: Hidden Depths
1614270.desc: 在沉沒世界中的美麗遺跡乘船、攀爬、互動和探索。

464880.name: Stars in Shadow
464880.desc: Stars in Shadow is a turn-based 4X strategy game and a vivid tribute to the genre classics. Compete with alien factions to explore and colonize nearby starsystems, build fleets to defend against rivals, negotiate or conquer them. Win by unifying the galaxy, through diplomacy or force.

2051120.name: HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED™ 2 - Turbocharged
2051120.desc: 全球最炫酷的賽車回來了，帶來了更多的樂趣！超過130輛車輛可以駕駛，瘋狂的新機械裝置和更多的車型可供選擇。此外，還有令人驚嘆的新環境和不同的遊戲模式，在線上和線下建造你自己的賽道，享受更多的樂趣！

979120.name: Autonauts
979120.desc: 你负责殖民无人星球，从一无所有开始，采集自然资源，建造一个无所不学，无所不会的机器人帝国。自动化是这个游戏的精髓——不断提升科技水平，实现生活完全自动化，达到绝对的自主！

movies.name: Autonauts - Age of Enlightenment - Launch Trailer

416790.name: The Metronomicon: Slay The Dance Floor
416790.desc: A Rhythm Role-Playing Game! Fight party crashing monsters with the power of music! Level your party and upgrade your gear while dancing to the beat of some groovin' tunes. Grab a friend and combine forces in all game modes in The Metronomicon: Slay the Dance Floor!

movies.name: Slay The Dance Floor - Release Trailer

compare.en: The Metronomicon: Slay The Dance Floor

1199030.name: Tainted Grail: Conquest
1199030.desc: A unique, infinitely replayable, story-driven hybrid between a deck-building Roguelike and an RPG game. Explore the ever-changing maps, fight with deadly enemies, and learn what happened to the cursed island of Avalon.

999220.name: Amnesia: Rebirth
999220.desc: A first-person horror adventure. Uncover your past and survive the Algerian desert. Fear is your enemy; stay calm to not succumb to an illness threatening you and your loved one. Avoid darkness, hide from monsters and solve puzzles. Adventure Mode available for a less scary experience.

219640.name: Chivalry: Medieval Warfare
219640.desc: 在 Chivalry: Medieval Warfare 中攻城掠地，這是一款注重多人連線的快節奏中世紀第一人稱砍殺遊戲

223220.name: Giana Sisters: Twisted Dreams
223220.desc: 《吉娜姐妹：扭曲夢境》是一款刺激的專家模式平台遊戲，擁有兩個截然不同的世界。

1743850.name: HYPER DEMON
1743850.desc: HYPER DEMON is an FPS like no other. a pearl of lightning. a dream from the future. a drop of poison. a swan song. The faster you slay demons, the harder the game and the higher your score. There is an end. Will it see you?

top.text: confusing even for me, an ultrakill player

1447000.name: MotoGP™21
1447000.desc: 站上起跑順位，準備好體驗迄今最身歷其境的 MotoGP™ 電玩遊戲。 享受新 MotoGP™21 最真實的二輪競速體驗！

top.text:
畫面逼真流暢、音效臨場感十足、操作感絕佳、介面簡潔明瞭 ，各方面都做得非常棒👍，
前不久買RIDE 4非常喜歡，MotoGP 21價格不貴就原價入手了👍

原本是先玩了RIDE4但是突然覺得RIDE4有點膩了就買了MotoGP21原本以為操控差不多應該很好上手,結果突然覺得MotoGP21才是真正的摔車模擬器,熟悉了好一段時間才終於比較習慣,玩了MotoGP21突然覺得RIDE4(難度已調整至實際情況了)的輪胎好抓歐,MotoGP21更考驗油門煞車還有傾角控制的細膩度,前煞太多後輪浮起灣中油門太多傾角太深厚輪開滑就沒辦法做出很好的成績來,而且還要隨時注意剩餘的油量來調整動力模式,如果一直使
用鍵盤的確又些難度,遊戲反饋很真實,不過很快就上手了,遊戲細緻度很棒還有眾多細節,值得遊玩

1944430.name: Amnesia: The Bunker
1944430.desc: Amnesia: The Bunker is a first-person horror game set in a WW1 bunker. A relentless, AI-driven monster stalks you. Survival depends on finding tools, crafting items, and keeping the lights on.

top.text: 玩起來更像是惡整你的解謎遊戲，怪物一開始很恐怖，三小時候就變得很煩了。太多門根本打不開，為了打開一個門拿裡面的道具，必須要跑到地圖的另一端拿鑰匙，重點是你根本不知道這個鑰匙一開始藏在哪裡，而且為了這個鑰匙，你還要先找屍體，拿狗牌密碼，然後再開置物櫃拿筆記，然後上面才告訴你鑰匙位置之類的前置作業一大堆，所以整個遊戲主角都像無頭蒼蠅一樣折返跑。

357310.name: Oriental Empires
357310.desc: Turn based 4X strategy game, recreating the civilizations of ancient China. Develop your land, build great cities, raise huge armies and fight epic battles, with hundreds of soldiers fighting right on the game map. Advance your technologies, culture and religion to create one of mankind’s biggest empires.

top.text: 玩這種大戰略最怕全英文，文字量一多就會懶得看，像是十字軍之王2等paradox出的大戰略很多眉角要釐清就會讓人卻步。幸好Oriental Empires已經有簡中漢化，而且操作上沒那麼刁鑽。遊戲給的操作提示不多，所以剛玩要慢慢摸，不過對玩過全戰系列Total war玩家來說很好上手。比較可惜的是一些AI尋路徑問題好像沒有修正，以及戰鬥呈現有點僵硬外算不錯的作品；在價格上比起paradox那種遊戲本體便宜但DLC花費可觀的遊戲來說這遊戲C

節奏很緩慢的文明帝國類遊戲，
背景是參考春秋戰國時代，
科技樹分四系，演進有三個時代。

戰鬥方面:
是以地圖上直接戰鬥的模式，類似Total war但不能部隊微調，
所以還是用數量去壓制，戰鬥起來很無趣看不到兵兵戶打的狀況。
兵種就算比較有趣了，兵有分平民與貴族，
某方太多時會造成動亂的成因，所以要平衡。

建築方面:
一階城市有固定的空位去蓋建築，
需要升級城市來獲得更多空位。
農田與城外建築是在地圖上直接建築。
建築的缺點就是看不

目前还只是一个预览版本，坐等制作组加入承诺的中文字幕，这个是超重点哦。
战役模式能够扩充一下就更完美了。特别要说画面问题，还是不错的，重点要看和谁去比较，和全面战争系列？那明显不可能，制作费也不是一个级别的。可是如果你要和三国志13，信长野望去比？完爆光荣好几条街。如果你可以接受光荣游戏的画面，没有任何理由不接受这东方帝国

290300.name: Rebel Galaxy
290300.desc: Rebel Galaxy is a swashbuckling space adventure, with action-packed combat, exploration, discovery, trade, and “negotiation” with the outlandish denizens at the edge of the known universe.

top.text: 玩法單一但是放鬆!

22180.name: Penumbra Overture
22180.desc: Penumbra: Overture is a first person survival horror game, emphasizing on survival and problem solving instead of mindless violence and gore.

top.text: 作為系列的第一部作品，這款科幻恐怖遊戲包含大量的解謎元素。可能因為年代較為久遠，畫質顯得有些粗糙，戰鬥時的操作手感也差強人意。整個遊戲過程都局限在地下室進行，氣氛相當壓抑，且場景與地圖過於單一、缺乏變化。整體而言，我覺得表現中規中矩，個人評分：6/10。

306640.name: Battle Academy 2: Eastern Front
306640.desc: Sequel to its successful predecessor, Battle Academy 2 moves the action east – to the bloodied plains of Mother Russia. When a gritty new look, great new features, and random mission generation meet battle-proven gameplay you can be sure of a turn-based strategy classic!

top.text: great

433340.name: Slime Rancher
433340.desc: Slime Rancher is the tale of Beatrix LeBeau, a plucky, young rancher who sets out for a life a thousand light years away from Earth on the ‘Far, Far Range’ where she tries her hand at making a living wrangling slimes.

movies.name: Slime Rancher - Over 3 Million Copies Sold!
Slime Rancher - Viktor's Experimental Update Trailer

top.text: 很好玩，也是圆梦同年了。就是玩着容易迷路，还是得看攻略找史莱姆和藏宝球
好玩喵
好遊戲

357720.name: Inside My Radio
357720.desc: Can you beat the beat? Journey as a green LED mysteriously trapped inside a dying boombox and play the ultimate musical experience. In this rhythmic platform adventure where your every action needs to be right on the beat, bring electro, dub and disco music back to life!

top.text: 音樂很帶感，整體流程偏短，中間關卡基本沒難度，BOSS戰最後一關類似音遊，雖然譜面固定，但還是卡了半小時（怒砸鍵盤www。
i only use 2.3 hour end this game haha you guys know what than main ?  yes i can refund LOLLLLLLLLL
rhythm is enough but need more actions

23490.name: Tropico 3
23490.desc: Become the dictator of a remote island during the Cold War. Charm, persuade, intimidate, oppress, or cheat your people to stay in power! Are you a kind and generous leader? A corrupt and ruthless tyrant ruling with an iron fist?

top.text: 經典的策略(城市經營)遊戲~特殊的加勒比海風，黑色幽默以及令人上癮的有趣中南美口音XD
Can give me a chinese translate? i cant read anything QAQ

418250.name: Polaris Sector
418250.desc: Can anyone build an empire in a place like this? Other factions are naturally suspicious of newcomers and may wage war at the first sign of unidentified craft. Here, a natural death is an uncommon luxury.

top.text: intriguing, until mid-late game, the game then starts to just hang when you try upgrade fleets, build fleets or move fleets, game is pretty old now, so this is unlikely to ever be fixed... save your money, buy something

232970.name: Thunder Wolves
232970.desc: 當這群「狼群」出擊時，你會聽到雷聲滾滾。雷狼小組（Thunder Wolves）從空中發起進攻。他們是雇傭兵，也是世界上最頂尖的直升機飛行員。他們每一個人都時刻準備著行動——並隨時準備打擊邪惡，無論它藏身何處。

top.text:
全程暴力轟炸輸出，純粹追求一個爽字！
本身機體移動操作蠻絲滑的，且畫面穩定度很好，玩起來舒服~~
可能唯一不喜歡的就是BOSS戰，技術太差打不太到，傷心。
P.S：遊戲內狙擊模式超扯，明顯歪一大截，但敵人還是死掉了，那個準新判定範圍超大，讚！！
你需要一位朋友並且附加一對應手把才能完成全部成就，Good Job！ :)))
这游戏当年玩的时候感觉很爽，真的

598730.name: Shakedown: Hawaii
598730.desc: Build a "legitimate" corporation via open world missions, shakedowns, sabotage and property acquisition.

top.text: This is a fantastic game & should be introduced into the school curriculum to show kids how corrupt capitalism works for the One percent. I didn't get any bugs. Go have some fun.
fun, silly, and simple open world game <3

This game is so boring. I was expecting Retro City Rampage which was an excellent game. You spend most of the game on the phone talking to people. It feels like the game is playing itself. Gameplay is very repetitive.

1634860.name: Minishoot' Adventures
1634860.desc: 飛進手工打造的迷人世界，開始一場開放式探索和爽快雙搖杆射擊動作的冒險。從光亮的地上世界一路殺到最幽深的洞穴，改良你的飛船，擊敗地下城中的首領，救出自己的朋友！

top.text: 就.....打飛機版的2D薩爾達，只是把角色怪物NPC換成小飛船。謎題解謎不難，大部分是在找路，加速後的衝刺與甩尾速度感操作起來還不錯，其他的就比較一般。

享受探索跟成長的部分很不錯
非常好玩！
根本就是射擊版超任蕯爾達傳說，好玩

327410.name: A Bird Story
327410.desc: An experimental short from the creator of To the Moon & Finding Paradise: A simple & surreal 1-hour interactive animation about a boy and an injured bird, told without dialogues.If you're looking for To the Moon-like experience, I'd suggest playing Finding Paradise first.

top.text:
算是 Finding Paradise 的前傳短篇故事，時間軸和製作時間都比 Finding Paradise 早。
有玩過 Finding Paradise 的人可以補，但對沒玩過的人而言有點沒頭沒尾的。
很舒服的小品故事

5061040.name: Quartermark
5061040.desc: 你的隊伍會自己戰鬥。誰在隊伍裡、他們帶著什麼，由你決定——這就是整個遊戲。12 名英雄、9 個可串聯成金色連攜的關鍵字、100 張地圖、440 隻怪誕的 3D 怪物、100 個首領，以及可能毀掉你最強裝備的強化階梯。

3825930.name: Aolta
3825930.desc: You've woken up after a millennium with no memory of your life before. You've become an alien in your own planet. This world is yours to discover.

5056360.name: Crypt Survivor
5056360.desc: 深入受詛咒的地穴，體驗這款動作 Roguelite 遊戲。駕馭各具特色的職業，搭配強力升級，獲得被擊敗首領的能力。闖過危機四伏的五層地穴，打破詛咒；或在無盡模式中挑戰你的極限。

top.text:
What I expected: Casual Roguelike experience
What I got: A raging boner from the soundtrack

1558620.name: 麻雀旅人
1558620.desc: 摸三張牌，選一張走路；用牌袋構築，用一局真正的麻將打倒 Boss。《麻雀旅人》是一款 HD-2D 像素風的休閒麻將肉鴿：走遍四風群島，堵上麻將規矩的漏洞，趕在封印破開之前抵達封魔潭。

movies.name: 麻雀旅人 宣傳片（繁體）

2105440.name: Fall of Bali
2105440.desc: Fall of Bali is a historical strategy game set in Bali set around 19th century. Divided into many kingdoms after fall of Bali Empire, Bali has seen war for nearly two centuries and now the threat of imperialism has come. 5218590.name: Turrakata

5246400.name: Bloom
5246400.desc: A puzzle-platformer about an innocent, curious being exploring the planets of Bloom, planting seeds and sprouting flowers with its song. Sing! Use your voice and impact the ecosystem that birthed you, and become one with the cosmos.

5327190.desc: A chaotic festival tent simulator for up to 4 players. Run your own Oktoberfest beer tent, serve beer and food, expand your business, hire staff, brew your own beer, and sabotage the competition.

3847310.desc: BONG FLIP is a fast-paced arcade game about launching, flipping, dodging enemies, and landing. Build your score, collect ridiculous skins, and see what you can survive before you crash. Flip it. Land it.

4354660.name: Zone Nova
4354660.desc: Commandant, the world is in danger! Lead powerful Novas from ancient civilizations into the Forbidden Zones in this squad‑based RTS ARPG, battle monsters from the black spheres and seduce every maiden. Enjoy real‑time combat, idle growth, explosive battles and lewd fun all in one adventure.

5189370.desc: 用陷阱規劃敵人的行進路線，再用這些陷阱消滅敵人的 Roguelite 據點防禦遊戲。封住要道，把敵人逼進同一條路，在那條路上設置陷阱，每一波結束後從三張卡牌中選一張，獲得新的陷阱。敵人會鑿穿牆壁、拆毀陷阱，一路殺來。

top.text: 這是一個獨特的科幻塔防遊戲。以玩家為攻方的基礎，提供了全面機種和能力支援，並且配合自定路線，玩家可因應戰況改變戰術。這一切都令遊戲巨有娛樂的、技巧的原素。
策略上，有時需要隨時做調整，不免就是要全力以赴，對於這遊戲我給予評價甚高，加上控制起來相當簡單，不會過於複雜，難度水平我還能接受，不過有些敵人真的有夠討厭。

精美的畫面，簡單的操作，算是一款非常優質的小遊戲

敵人的攻擊稍微看一下就知道怎麼應對，加上指揮官強大，基本上沒卡過關

逆塔防類型的遊戲，這種遊戲類型沒這麼常見

3216230.name: MEAT TRAIN
3216230.desc: Meat Train is a FPS game where you operate a train thats uses MEAT for FUEL. Explore a wasteland where everything wants you dead, scavenge for weapons and loot. Upgrade the train and attempt to destroy an evil AI megafactory.

top.text: Taking the time to write a review as i reckon the dev deserves more love for this game. This one has been on the wishlist for a while and just saw it was on sale so i bought it and went into it without to crazy expectati
MEAT MEAT MEAT MEAT MEAT!
i liked it its a ton of fun

5134560.name: DON'T SWITCH
5134560.desc: Co-op horror for 2-3 friends. Ransack a haunted mansion for cursed tapes, wake the spectres and blast them back to hell with a holy cross. Keep your energy up: the thing in the walls can possess you, and then YOU are the one hunting your friends.

4509200.name: Grease Trap '99
4509200.desc: Mystery Horror / Comedic Takeaway Simulator. Deep-fry pizzas and live the Scottish dream. Voice-acted in Scottish Gaelic; subtitles in English or Gaelic.

1508190.name: Finding Words
1508190.desc: Open a magical storybook and find the words that bring its tales to life. Complete 50 word-search puzzles across ten funny fantasy stories, fill in the missing passages and collect charming stickers, one discovery at a time. Play at your own pace.

4731070.name: Kron Wars
4731070.desc: A persistent space MMO that runs in your browser. No download. No installation. Open a tab and you are in the Frontier. Trade, mine and fight across 2 universes and 12,000 sectors, in an economy that players build. And one mechanic that no other MMO has: war rewrites the map.

5101820.name: カスペナ～カスタムペナント野球
5101820.desc: 從選秀發掘新秀，培養自己的球員，帶領球隊挑戰冠軍。在這款棒球經營模擬遊戲中，你將擔任總經理，決定打線、投手起用、自由球員補強、交易與續約。探索球員各自的成長樹、尋找隱藏新秀，也能投資球場與周邊城鎮。比賽以觀戰方式進行，不直接操作球員；不想親自處理的工作可以交給電腦。球隊、聯盟規則與球員姓名風格皆可自訂。

3422000.name: Ward Off Evil
3422000.desc: Ward Off Evil is an open world strategy RPG set in an apocalyptic sword & sorcery world. Create your character, rally an army, and roam the wastes as you battle to avert, or bring about, the end of the Cycle.

top.text: Really cool game. Combat is self-explainatory and challenging. The world presented in the game is pretty decent lore-wise. I like consistency of the art style. It has some niances, like the map could be preserved from on

Love RPG? Make sure to Follow my Curator PageI liked the game. It's like indie Wartales, but with a completely different setting. Magic, monsters, quests, and multiple endings. There are still plenty of flaws (no main qu

5292500.name: ゆめみるサクラの卒業式
5292500.desc: 畢業典禮正逐漸走向崩潰。這本應是再尋常不過的一天，你只需要選擇先開口向哪位朋友打招呼。打招呼的順序會改變對話的內容，同時令周遭的景致在一次次的輪迴中變得扭曲。不知為何，好友漸漸收起了臉上的笑容。等你察覺到真相的時候，畢業典禮也將不復當初。這是一部以友情為主題的互動聲畫讀物。每重複一周目，令人不忍直視的真相都將變得更加清晰——包括破碎的過程在內，精緻而細膩。

3323980.name: Sweet Swipe
3323980.desc: 在 《Sweet Swipe》 中，奔跑、跳躍和滑行，盡顯風格！一款令人興奮的 2D 平台遊戲，操作簡單，跑酷風格的動作，手繪街頭藝術，原創配樂，以及一個關於勇氣、韌性和正義的精彩故事。

4996960.name: Handle with Care!
4996960.desc: A co-op delivery game where you play as tiny postal workers in a town that’s trying to kill you. Deliver everything from coffins to ticking bombs, escape rabid dogs and berserk drivers, and stay in business for six days to earn your pint on Sunday.

top.text:
Question - Did I just spend nearly three hours wiggling my bean's butt and spanking people?

Answer - Yes.

10/10 would give myself repetitive spank injury again

(also works great on steam deck)

Funslop 

Love the theme and the familiar British town vibe. Also BUMS. BUTTS. Whatever your preferred rear end terminology is this game has em nice and peachy and jiggly and SLAPPABLE. 

5/5 for a fiver(99)

5364850.name: Doomward: Dungeon Autobattler
5364850.desc: Run a guild of doomed heroes. Hire, specialize, gear and program them, then watch every fight play itself. A roguelike autobattler with permadeath, town sieges and a raid-boss Herald at the end of the Doom Clock. Solo, co-op for up to 4, or PvP.

1564060.name: 疯狂灯塔 Lighthouse of Madness
1564060.desc: 踏上這段受洛夫克拉夫特啟發的奇幻之旅，揭開這座島嶼上等待著你的謎團。 探索島嶼，破解棘手的謎題，最重要的是：儘量別失去理智。

movies.name: Lighthouse of Madness - Official Release Date Trailer

5341000.name: Ashnar's Lair
5341000.desc: A traditional roguelike built around your character. Unlock seven classes by your deeds, grow them through three talent trees and hunt gear with rolled affixes. Elite foes and whole dungeons roll affixes too, and every one changes how you fight. One life per run. Will you defeat Ashnar?

5346530.name: ZakuzakuTreasure
5346530.desc: Battles run on their own. Send a party of four into dungeons, scoop up piles of gear, upgrade it, and push deeper. With levels up to 999 and over 100 dungeons, this is an idle hack-and-slash RPG that keeps going while you watch.

4303660.name: Wartide
4303660.desc: 一款駐留在螢幕角落的增量式桌面防禦遊戲。波次越來越難，升級越來越強，進度永不停止。在工作或休息時建設基地、解鎖永久加成、壯大軍隊。

2862170.name: Elderwood Online Demo
2862170.desc: Dive back into the golden age of MMORPGs. Leveling is the journey, not a sprint: every level is earned, builds take real thought, and the world grows wider, never taller. No auto-play, no shortcuts to endgame, no pay-to-win. Made by a solo indie developer for those who love the long climb.

4247410.name: Run, Run from the Blast!
4247410.desc: Challenge yourself in a frantic escape through an urban environment, where every mistake brings you one step closer to your demise. Only a perfect run will truly give you a chance to make it out alive.

2488560.name: Abandoned Hearts
2488560.desc: Abandoned Hearts is a single-player detective horror game. Investigate a fatal castle fire, connect clues on an evidence board, and draw your own conclusions. Run, hide, and distract what stalks the halls. The families need answers. You need to make it out alive.

movies.name: Abandoned Hearst — Official Reveal Trailer | Mythbyte

5144200.name: Hurl
5144200.desc: HURL is a multiplayer platform game where you battle your friends in a gutty arena. The winner transforms into a massive worm, and eats away the terrain to create the next map.

883710.name: Resident Evil 2
883710.desc: 一切都凌駕於玩家的想像之上。 一場生化災難於1998年9月襲擊了浣熊市，從殘害倖存者的喪屍地獄中生還吧。 無盡的刺激、引人入勝的故事和無法想像的恐怖正在等候你。 見證系列首屈一指的傑作──《Resident Evil 2》的重生吧。 別被這場慘劇吞噬。

top.text: 剛打完舔食者下一秒就被喪屍突臉，有夠恐怖QAQ
這遊戲是我跟艾達結婚前不太熟的時期有點青澀的回憶

艾達王依舊權威 你礙事梨還在上課的時候里昂叔叔就已經迷上她了
如果是對這種類型不熟悉的建議選最簡單的模式 我玩一般覺得子彈很少被虐殭屍虐很慘

367500.name: Dragon's Dogma: Dark Arisen
367500.desc: 廣受好評的RPG動作遊戲Dragon's Dogma: Dark Arisen，現已推出高清版本，並包括所有先前收費DLC內容。

top.text: 無聊，非常瑣碎，地圖空曠毫無探索慾
很好玩

2050650.name: Resident Evil 4
2050650.desc: 生還僅是惡夢的開端。 前所未見的生物災害「拉昆市事件」已過去六年。 成為特務的里昂·S·甘迺迪接獲命令，前往營救被綁架的總統千金。 為此里昂踏進被「瘋狂」支配之地，他的結局會是…… 一場生與死、恐懼與釋懷互相交織的嚴酷營救劇即將揭開帷幕。 透過直觀的操作和最新的畫面，以及再構成的故事重生為全新的生存恐怖體驗。

top.text:
建議一定要玩艾達線!
觀察里昂模擬器
非常好玩

里昂帥到出水...
本篇通關完畢，非常讚的英雄救美劇情，也不愧是動作天尊卡普空，通篇下來超級帶感!
惡靈古堡經典神作，十分值得試試看，原價就對得起他的遊戲體驗和演出了，打折下去那更是值得中的值得
完全給我玩爽了

艾達和艾殊莉也都非常讚，值得多品<3

順帶提恐怖的部分我是覺得完全不恐怖的，真的戰鬥爽，有興趣的人真的真的要試試看!

回憶變成全面加強版回歸沒搞砸
整個過程跟去主題樂園玩一樣開心邊玩邊笑

21690.name: Resident Evil 5
21690.desc: 這遊戲是在2009年推出的Games for Windows - Live version。如果你在Steam上購買Untold Stories Bundle，它將會升級令內容與Resident Evil 5 Gold Edition相同。

top.text:
玩過其它重製版再回來玩，這代子彈給非常充足就是9格背包太小
支援超寬螢幕，高幀率，寬螢幕建議裝相關修正MOD不然會玩到吐
老兵難度QTE時間變短，受擊傷害變高，但子彈還是很多 火力及正義
逢年過節必折，覺得貴可以等骨折連DLC一起入手
找朋友一起玩得，我不一樣我只想玩他 (X
本作克里斯體術真的太好笑了，還有威斯卡閃子彈、手刀衝刺
全程笑著玩沒驚嚇點，非常喝勝非常推薦
我本來想回來玩玩五代的  玩到第4章 就出現存當異常 直接存檔消失 我就刪遊戲了 QTE很煩打巨人超煩...
這ai真氣笑了 操作跟地圖設計都有點拉但能看到拳擊石頭一切都值了

304240.name: Resident Evil
304240.desc: 生存恐怖類型的遊戲回歸！這是重新製作的高清版Resident Evil。

top.text: Great, but without door-skipping mod each door gives an animation that takes a few seconds which is only annoying so i recommend using the mod if you wish to play this.
好玩好玩，經典又復古的經典之作 特價144玩一下不是浪費硬碟空間的GG
如果沒有攻略 我這輩子可能都要困在洋館迷路了

952060.name: Resident Evil 3
952060.desc: 不管逃到哪裡也會被追至絕路。 拉昆市發生突如其來的生物災害，更為巨大的威脅被投入至這個逐漸崩潰的城鎮中…… 多重的危機、九死一生的驚險動作和重新建構的逃生劇，一一超乎你的預想。 你能逃離這片絕望嗎？ 同時收錄《Resident Evil Resistance》。

top.text: 流程短但非常好玩，骨折價完全物超所值
雖然劇情不長，但是經典好玩。

可以理解3代被詬病的地方，解謎要素真的少太多了，地圖介面也不如2、4代好懂。
但基本上還是推薦玩完2代接著玩3代，有些2代的細節會在3代得到呼應，
像是馬文警官的遭遇、淋浴間牆上的洞是怎麼來的，
以及那張消失的置物櫃筆記——Carlos，你就說是不是你拿走的？！

1967430.name: Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective
1967430.desc: 經典的解謎神秘冒險名作回來了！ 《逆轉裁判》系列作者巧　舟所製作的《Ghost Trick: Phantom Detective》，將推出期待已久的高清重製版。 由負責《大逆轉裁判》BGM的人氣作曲家北川保昌對原版樂曲進行的同期編曲外，還有插畫集和BGM集等新追加內容！

top.text:
過程跟演出有趣到想忘掉都難
我會永遠記得裡面的舞步 

這就是巧舟在逆轉裁判的幽默與大膽
以全新的載體跟玩法呈現出來的結果啊

請在不要接觸任何劇情暴雷的情況下打開 會擁有最好的體驗

巧舟哥的全盛時期，恐怖如斯。
精巧有趣的謎題與解謎，獨此一家。
如齒輪般契合的劇情，前後呼應的巨北。
初見很糙但是後來發現特別有表現力的畫面，
還有特別抓耳，一聽就知道什麼東西要來了的音樂。

強烈推薦。
创意非常不错

1196590.name: Resident Evil Village
1196590.desc: 在《Resident Evil》主系列的第8部作品中展開一場令人毛骨悚然的絕命拚搏。 伊森一家的平靜生活又再一次被捲進了混亂之中，而打破這種平靜日常的不是別人，正是克里斯·雷德菲爾。伊森又再一次陷入那無法醒來的噩夢。 經過多年開發，日趨成熟的RE Engine為大家打造了全新的生存「動作」恐怖體驗。

top.text: 延續7代的劇情，蠻令人喜歡的，也有延續很重的沉浸感和劇情，蠻不錯的

9 / 10
精彩的演出，系列最好的大场景。东欧奇幻恶灵古堡，精彩刺激的冒险。
缺点，明显给RE4预备的素材，前期压迫十足最后BOSS挂的草率，以及剧情杀。
浪费塑造好的反派
好玩到翻掉，可以充分感受到自己成長的遊戲，特價時入手絕對超值，過關後有機會可以體驗村影模式，會感到非常的有趣

1277400.name: Monster Hunter Stories 2: 破滅之翼
1277400.desc: 《MONSTER HUNTER STORIES》是一款RPG遊戲，玩家將會成為與魔物建立羈絆、加以培育並與之共存的「騎士」，在「Monster Hunter」的世界中冒險。本作為系列第二彈，有關羈絆的全新故事將會揭開帷幕。

top.text:

按這個道理來看我這個評論應該會建立起我跟大家的羈絆之力給我的銀行帳號匯款啊？

45740.name: Dead Rising® 2
45740.desc: 銷量破百萬的Dead Rising續集，今次Dead Rising 2將喪屍及生存恐怖遊戲，一次過帶進美國最新最大的娛樂主題公園Fortune City。

top.text:
他媽的什麼爛遊戲
沒有做繁體中文的語音包
說什麼找不到這個這個檔案
在那邊玩遊戲我之前還是以前小時候回憶在玩的時候都是盜版的全部都用好了然後什麼都沒有問題我現在回來支持新版的正版的
我還要幫他安裝繁體語音MOD
沒有自動存檔然後還不能存檔我到底要怎麼玩

如果我沒先玩過3代，這遊戲我仍然不會給正面評價，因為同時期的死亡之島完全吊打這部作品。
沒錯，這系列強在於有大量惡搞元素，但嚴格說起來玩遊戲性本身還是不夠好。
雖然同樣與死亡之島系列一樣都允許玩家改裝武器，可是一來武器的耐用度真的還是不夠，殭屍數量又比死亡之島的還多好幾倍，常常打到一半武器就壞掉，然後要重做一把又得到處找材料。
好用的武器就那幾種，最強大的往往都無法藏在身上，玩家角色一受到攻擊或是碰到些什麼，手上那把藏不住的武器就

265550.name: Dead Rising 3 Apocalypse Edition
265550.desc: 探索被喪屍病毒感染的Los Perdidos城，並在軍方介入突擊並掃平整個城市之前，連同所有生還者尋找逃出之路。

top.text:
不錯玩 一些組合武器或車輛玩起來很有樂趣.難度不會太高可以一定程度上輕鬆玩
劇情上我覺得也不會太突兀.簡單易懂的好
可以帶上生還者一起冒險也頗有趣味.小夥伴們也不至於太弱.不需要平凡照顧這點很好
有些支線任務太過麻煩.單一個支線任務就要人跑遍整區地圖也太誇張
有些要找武器或道具的任務沒有指引有點麻煩
且有些任務需要找的道具還佔用物品欄位.初期會感到吃力
但總體來說玩得很開心.值得推薦~

222480.name: Resident Evil Revelations
222480.desc: Resident Evil® Revelations 以高質素高清畫質、強化光影效果及音效重臨 PC 平台。

movies.name: Resident Evil Revelations Dev Diary: Heritage Horror

top.text: 什麼?你說你遊戲都快結束了還不會閃避?那恭喜，準備被最終boss當狗搧，一搧一個不吱聲，你說靠走位?不好意思，繞背搧，幻影搧，無呼吸連搧，你說AI隊友怎麼不吸引仇恨?不好意思，我克里斯就是原地手槍連射，挪動半步?不存在的
童年回憶，操作簡單又不缺乏趣味，主線大概9小時通關，總共12章，遊戲內沒有遇過一次bug
nice

548430.name: Deep Rock Galactic
548430.desc: Deep Rock Galactic 是一款可以 1 至 4 人同時遊玩的多人合作第一人稱射擊遊戲，有酷酷的太空矮人、100% 可破壞的環境、程式生成的洞穴以及無數的外星怪物。

top.text:
目前遊玩時間大約 71 小時，基本上都是跟認識的人一起玩。

我自己最喜歡這款遊戲的地方，就是它的職業分工真的做得非常明確。偵查兵靈活、可以照明，挖礦也方便；工程兵可以做平台給偵查兵踩，還有機槍塔可以補火力；鑽頭兵負責挖路；機槍兵則是有很多高破壞力武器。四個職業真的是各司其職，而且少了哪一個都會很有感。像少偵查兵，挖礦會慢很多、照明也不夠；少鑽頭兵，開路就會變得超級麻煩。四個人一起玩的時候，合作感真的非常強。

隨機生成的洞穴地圖也很不
玩的我在MC裡挖礦也猛按F
低氧關卡我耖

top.text:

   2星級- 小作、同人等級的小品水準、電波粉絲向
   1星級- 差作、各方面極差缺陷多、看網路攻略或吐槽就好
   0星級- 糞作、遊戲界黑歷史、爛到連玩盜版都嫌浪費時間

劇情沒門檻，因為走的是不同舊三部曲劇

2291670.name: Deep Rock Galactic - Supporter II Upgrade
2291670.desc: 為了慶祝 DRG 五週年，我們現在向我們最熱衷的玩家們推出贊助者資格 2。

1430610.name: Deep Rock Galactic - Roughneck Pack
1430610.desc: 如果你真的很想幹點粗活的話，新的血汗礦工包將可以助你一臂之力。用這四套全新的獨特裝甲（每種職業各一套）、全新的頭盔、和全新的塗裝好好打扮一番吧

801860.name: Deep Rock Galactic - Supporter Upgrade
801860.desc: 你喜歡 Deep Rock Galactic，但覺得這樣不夠，還想要更多嗎？那麼贊助者資格正好適合你！資助我們的遊戲開發流程，然後到遊戲內領取贊助者專屬的獎勵吧！

2934390.name: Deep Rock Galactic - Order of the Deep Pack
2934390.desc: 深淵戰兵附加下載內容將會給你一套備受敬重的矮人採礦公會的專屬裝甲。現在是你出面代表戰兵團的時候了，朝著危險的深淵邁向更遠的地方吧。

1797340.name: Deep Rock Galactic - Rival Tech Pack
1797340.desc: 敵對科技組合包可以讓你用我們的新敵人的風格裝飾你的武器，畢竟也沒什麼理由浪費掉這些精良的零件，對吧！

920571.name: Resident Evil 2 - All In-game Rewards Unlocked
920571.desc: 以下內容原本只能在達到指定紀錄後才可獲得，現在可以立即為它們解鎖： - 額外模式：「第 4 生還者」 - 額外模式：「豆腐生還者」 - 服裝 - 無限獎勵武器 - 概念美術 - 模型 ※不包括「幽靈生還者」的紀錄達成報酬。

3481460.name: Deep Rock Galactic - Skullcrusher Pack
3481460.desc: 碎顱猛者附加下載內容將會給你一套碎顱者氏族的祖傳裝甲，這是一個和碎顱烈酒有著相同名號的好戰氏族。據說這套裝甲仍會回應戰爭號角的召喚，並且渴望著再次被人披戴上陣的時刻。

2165590.name: Deep Rock Galactic - Biohazard Pack
2165590.desc: 岩痘已經蔓延到哈克瑟斯上，而我們強悍的礦工們必須穿上精良的裝備對抗它！用這四套全新的獨特裝甲（每種職業各一套）、全新的頭盔、和全新的塗裝好好打扮一番吧。

1283091.name: Deep Rock Galactic - MegaCorp Pack
1283091.desc: 研發部門工業用壓力機出品的最新成果！該是時候為你的武器和裝備換上最新型的設計美學了 - 這套公司認證的業界龍頭組合包正好可以滿足這項需求：全套的業界龍頭裝備外觀

3535330.name: Terraspace
3535330.desc: The game "Terraspace" offers you a unique experience of planet settlement and terraforming — creating conditions for life on unsuitable planets. This will require you to build the necessary structures to populate the planet.

881020.name: Granblue Fantasy: Relink
881020.desc: 以4人隊伍聯手作戰，王道動作RPG遊戲！ 擁有專屬動作特色的眾多角色登場。在共同作戰中接連使出招式，透過4人集中攻擊的「連結攻擊」與「奧義連擊」，華麗地打倒敵人吧。 極具深度的戰鬥模式加上自由度高的培育系統，還有能因應玩家情況，讓動作遊戲新手也能充分享受遊戲的輔助功能。 大家一起組隊，盡情享受冒險與戰鬥吧！

3764200.name: Resident Evil Requiem
3764200.desc: 予生者恐懼。給屍者安魂。 《Resident Evil Requiem》標誌著「Resident Evil」系列和生存恐怖遊戲的新紀元即將開始。「Requiem」（安魂曲）將會撼動玩家的精神深處。

4761040.name: Its Flammin Bingo
4761040.desc: Its Flammin Bingo is a rougelike strategy game about playing bingo. Buy and use items in the shop to weigh the odds in your favor. Earn enough points to complete each round and earn coins. Gain bingo after bingo to thrive.

3567020.name: Mumble Pines: The Arrival
3567020.desc: In this first-person story-driven horror game, you take a job as a janitor to access a run-down island summer camp that got shut down, after the dissapearence of your younger brother, which was only one of many incidents. It’s up to you to uncover the island’s buried secrets.

4833540.name: Juice Stand Tycoon
4833540.desc: Turn a tiny street-corner juice stand into the hit of the festival. Mix recipes for the weather, set prices and stock up before the rush. Customers tell you exactly why they walked away, so fix it on the fly and keep the cash rolling in. Eight levels. Try Level 1 free.

3991200.name: Momolitos
3991200.desc: 探索充滿活力的地區，收集材料並餵養可愛的 Momolitos，幫助牠們進化成數百種獨特的形態。這是一場溫馨的生物收集冒險，結合了探索、發現，以及照顧自己充滿好奇生命的實驗室的樂趣。

5077390.name: PCpill
5077390.desc: PCpill™ is an action-packed top-down shooter where you take control of the PCpill™ Antivirus to disinfect the hard drive of an old desktop PC. Use your PillGun to blast the rot away and restore your computer, one file at a time!

4813620.name: TankFall Arena
4813620.desc: Retro-inspired tank arena combat where every wall can become a weapon. Master ricochets, random battlefields, powerful pickups, and chaotic multiplayer battles against friends or AI opponents. Supports solo play, team battles, local multiplayer, and Remote Play Together.

5360850.name: Grind Grid
5360850.desc: A pixel-art incremental clicker-idler where 96 monsters and 32 idle blocks each level up independently. Hover your mouse — damage fires on its own. Prestige, evolutions, perks, tiers, and hundreds of upgrades. How far can you push the numbers?

5297330.name: Rescuing My Wife
5297330.desc: Your wife, Amanda, has been kidnapped by a family of demonic creatures. Explore the mansion, solve puzzles, defeat the demonic family members, and find Amanda.

3874160.name: NIPH
3874160.desc: NIPH 是一款風格獨特的 roguelite 平台遊戲，戰鬥激烈且充滿風險。在探索廣闊多樣的奇幻世界時，使用各式各樣的物品來進行斬擊、射擊、學習與施展魔法！

4751790.name: TRY
4751790.desc: A quiet evening turns into something far more unsettling. What begins as a normal night at home slowly changes as strange events, memories, and unexplained encounters begin to unfold.

5230710.name: FULL THROTTLE RALLY
5230710.desc: An arcade racing game inspired by 90s classics, where you race at high speed, master drifts, and tear through tracks inspired by Mexico.

3570930.name: Jessica's Choices - Forced [Episode 1]
3570930.desc: Your story continues right where Origins left off. Whether Jessica finds herself wandering the streets alone, caught in George’s web of deceit, or trapped in the unsettling confines of Margaret Thatuals under Professor Trounch’s watchful gaze and the orderlies, every choice matters.

5393320.name: NULLBYTE
5393320.desc: A puzzle about reading someone else's code and the one-byte mistake. A whole little machine on one screen: 256 cells, four registers, a stack. From "which way the stack grows" to a chain of borrowed code. You win not with the right answer, but with what the machine actually did.

5227650.name: Ration Me Tender
5227650.desc: An adult romance visual novel set at a coastal desalination plant during a supply crisis. Follow production director Nizar Sabhan through three distinct romance routes as work, marriage, and responsibility collide behind the fence at Ras Mishaal.

5288330.name: NOVA
5288330.desc: Conquer the galaxy one world at a time. Nova is a fast, minimalist real-time strategy game of fleets, factions and gravity. Send your forces between planets, portals and stations, outmaneuver seven rival AI factions, and survive black holes and asteroid belts across 12 chapters.

5208860.name: Dub House
5208860.desc: One to eight players, a party game where you only use your voice, Take a character each, record your lines, then watch it back with your takes where the actors used to be. Four modes: Dub, Telephone, Rap Booth. Plus a clip editor

5283650.name: Postpartum | 산후조리원
5283650.desc: 一款以韓國月子中心為舞台、為期五天的第一人稱心理恐怖遊戲。護理師在一夜之間換了人，而新來的那位，似乎總是抱著你的孩子。

3502620.name: 惡魔夜瘋狂
3502620.desc: 不分敵我全部殺殺殺！死越多越強的養成型RTA模擬RPG登場！運用殘酷無情的「剝削侍從系統」進行戰鬥，將邪惡發揮到極致！

5063150.name: 搖曳露營△ 相約搖曳露營△All -in -one!! Chill Time
5063150.desc: “讓人百看不厭” 當你伏案工作或學習時，《搖曳露營△》就陪伴在你的身旁。 在你身邊，凜、撫子和夥伴們今天也在享受露營的樂趣。看著她們的身影，你也能更專注於手邊的工作或學習。你可以利用1000多種裝備打造專屬的露營地，而那些全神貫注的時光，也將化作日記中的點滴記錄累積下來。

5104990.name: NARNOK: Help! I Was Reincarnated as a Brain in a Jar and Need to Plug In My Power Cables
5104990.desc: im a brain in a jar now and I got these cables that gotta be plugged in but there are many dangerous things in the way, so its always a PUZZLE to solve haha

5377200.name: Chained Pirates Together
5377200.desc: 一顆被詛咒的骷髏將你的船員鎖在一起，唯有塔頂的一道雷電才能打破詛咒。在這款適合 1–4 名海盜的物理合作攀爬遊戲中攀登 1000 公尺——一次失誤的跳躍，就會把所有人一起拖下去。

3844890.name: Lost Jelly
3844890.desc: An arcade adventure with a new twist!🚀 The alien robot Nimble must gather all the runaway Jelly after a crash landing. But there's a catch — his brakes are broken! Every move must be carefully planned, because once Nimble starts going, he won’t stop.

2757440.name: TCG: FANTASY Card Collection
2757440.desc: TCG: FANTASY Card Collection is a relaxing fantasy card-collecting game. Explore the room, discover thousands of cards, examine rare finds, and carefully organize your collection in cabinets by faction and rarity.

1713730.name: Moadra
1713730.desc: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

3734220.name: 末世神槍
3734220.desc: 這款類魂 FPS 遊戲，將你拉進傳奇美術總監 Viktor Antonov 筆下的末日西部：這片血染黃沙的詭秘之地。洞悉獵殺你的怪物、每顆子彈都要精打細算，用火藥與禱告鍛造你的專屬戰鬥風格。無論單槍匹馬或連線並肩作戰，槍手啊，向西行吧，跟這個沉淪的國度共赴終局。

Guns of Eschaton - Co-Op Mode Gameplay Teaser

1301950.name: Time Loader
1301950.desc: Time Loader is a story-driven puzzle-platformer with tiny robots, alternate realities, nostalgic music, and primitive tech from the 90s!

1119980.name: In Sound Mind
1119980.desc: In Sound Mind is an imaginative first-person psychological horror with frenetic puzzles, unique boss fights, and original music by The Living Tombstone. Journey within the inner workings of the one place you can’t seem to escape—your own mind.

297920.name: Space Colony: Steam Edition
297920.desc: Space Colony: Steam Edition is a remaster of the real-time base builder and strategy game from Firefly Studios, creators of the Stronghold series. In Space Colony you colonize to survive, designing intergalactic bases that keep your crew productive, happy and defended against hostile alien threats.

814360.name: Mythic Ocean
814360.desc: Teach the gods to create a better universe - or mess it all up in Mythic Ocean, a narrative exploration game where your choices shape the fate of the cosmos.

1630.name: Disciples II: Rise of the Elves
1630.desc: The award-winning series Disciples introduced a milestone in the game's very successful history; the introduction of a new race: The Elves. The Elven Race added a new dimension to the game and added countless hours of gameplay. Now that series has expanded further with Disciples II: Rise Of The Elves.

compare.en: Disciples II: Rise of the Elves

866140.name: Arise: A Simple Story
866140.desc: 踏上感傷的旅程，體驗失去心中所愛的失落。你將操縱時間，重塑環境，親歷一段段苦樂參半的回憶。這是一個關於快樂與苦難、喜悅與悲哀的故事，終有一天也將在你我身上重演。

2990.name: FlatOut 2
2990.desc: Experience the drive of your life as you throw yourself around on and off the track causing fences to shatter, tyre walls explode, water tanks and barrels fly across the track into other cars.

924070.name: Arboria
924070.desc: Fight, die, and fight again in this dark fantasy trollz-like roguelite. As a Yotun troll warrior, descend into the ever-changing, creepy dungeons of Durnar. Use a variety of Symbiotic Weapons and Bio-Mutations to slay enemies and heal The Father Tree.

6220.name: FlatOut
6220.desc: Ram through pile-ups and smash through your windshield as you push racing to the edge! FlatOut™ delivers more heart-stopping thrills than any sane driver can handle!

332200.name: Axiom Verge
332200.desc: Explore and uncover the mystery of a surreal alien world by blasting aliens and glitching your environment in this intense retro side-scrolling action/adventure.

1286320.name: Exoprimal
1286320.desc: 以人類最強大的「強攻裝甲」擊破史上最兇猛的「恐龍」的團隊對戰動作遊戲​​ 本作是一款線上專用團隊對戰動作遊戲，玩家將會身穿專為不同定位而設的最先進動力服「強攻裝甲」，對抗以壓倒性數量侵襲而來的「恐龍爆發」。

top.text: 感覺卡普空已經把這遊戲視為棄子了，不更新新玩法新恐龍，連強攻裝甲都是技能幾乎複製貼上的版本，都沒有完全全新的東西，現在匹配都是獵頭者，想要完全真人的對局基本都沒有都是跟AI打，舊的東西都玩得快膩了，希望卡普空還是能再多更新這款遊戲，畢竟我當時就是因為恐龍+機甲這個因素才買的遊戲。

525040.name: The Disney Afternoon Collection
525040.desc: 集合一群令人愛戴的迪士尼角色，《Disney Afternoon》將帶你回到遊戲黃金時代，讓冒險充實你的下午。 六款經典遊戲擁有經強化後的嶄新視覺效果，當中包含可回復至復古感覺的濾鏡選項功能。

top.text: 非学好玩游戏，童年的回忆~~

1406810.name: After Us
1406810.desc: 貪婪、犧牲，以及希望──在這扣人心弦的故事中四處探索荒誕的後人類世界的每一個角落，並給予地球上的生命第二次繁盛的機會。

top.text: 好玩的一款環保遊戲, 隨進度會越來越好玩, 期待2
場景美術超頂的

741510.name: The Hong Kong Massacre
741510.desc: 快節奏的俯視射擊遊戲，在香港街頭的槍林彈雨中殺出一條血路。 《The Hong Kong Massacre》受到經典的動作電影啟發，將您置身於一場無情的復仇之中，其中充滿了殘酷的影片式槍戰場景以及陰暗的地下交易場所。

top.text:
不是個可以無腦突突突就通關的爽 Game ，就連 John Wick 來也可能要在一關卡上重來上百回

可惜的地方在於後期的關卡，堆太多敵人了，也無檢查點，必須在毫髮無傷的情況下連殺三十餘名敵人

但總歸瑕不掩瑜，這款的帶給玩家的視覺聲效，真的玩起來很爽
我很少給遊戲負評，但這隻真的玩不下去，我香港人玩到一半已經感到極其無聊

3357650.name: PRAGMATA
3357650.desc: 《Pragmata》是Capcom的獨特科幻動作冒險遊戲。 命運多舛的調查小組成員休將與機器人女孩黛安娜合作，在被AI操控的月球設施中尋找返回地球的方法。

top.text: 非常好一款養女兒遊戲，尤其全程穿著塗鴉工作服在避難所互動以及打通關。整體遊戲性非常足，故事也完整，還好滑鼠有側鍵可以比較好操作。大多數BOSS戰鬥不會到非常難，有一定的規律在，甚至武器、晶片搭配好也好打許多。

2026/10/10 : 全成就
名副其實的養女兒遊戲
主線長度中等
其他都是收集要素或挑戰要素
流派構成算有但有些強力晶片要解真結局路線才會解鎖
推薦完多周目或NG+，有老卡一貫的通關後開始爽game模式

故事好，美術好，女兒好
遊戲性不好，剛開始還算有新意但玩差不多一半就膩了一度差點棄坑，因為不便宜還是逼自己打完了

5292740.name: Raze the Zombie Horde
5292740.desc: A single-player top-down zombie shooter across streets, fortresses, beaches and infected facilities. Adapt to two-sided run cards or build up to eight guns firing at once in Loot Arsenal. Develop four heroes and bring a tank, collie or robot dog on standard operations.

movies.name: Raze the Zombie Horde - Gameplay Trailer
Raze the Zombie Horde - Gameplay Trailer

4437140.name: if you stay
4437140.desc: Winter 1999. Kicked out of your house after being outed by your closest friend, you plan to leave your hometown. Your girlfriend, Mika, wants to see you one more time. Decide whether or not you'll stay together.

dlc.name: if you stay - creator support pack

5281080.name: 水族派對
5281080.desc: 《水族派對》是一款用心打造的畫風治癒、以海底模擬為題材的收集遊戲。在這裡，你將成為一家水族館的館長，打理萌魚海島的日常，收集超過 1000 種多類型的奇幻萌魚。

3191530.name: Irradiate 235
3191530.desc: Discover and automate unique materials. Engineer the machines and tools for your factory. Handle hazardous materials to make near-limitless energy. 981430.name: Gordian Quest

4607340.name: 伊莉亞娜公主的墜落之夜～她已不再屬於你～
4607340.desc: 魔王被擊敗後，勇者艾德蒙終於救回了摯愛的公主伊莉亞娜。然而，失去魔王制衡的世界再次陷入混亂。返程途中，勇者一行在溫泉旅館稍作休息，卻意外捲入一場圍繞權力與陰謀展開的危機。探索旅館、蒐集線索、與不同角色交流，並在關鍵時刻做出你的選擇。你的每一個決定都將影響故事的發展，並導向12種截然不同的結局。你能否揭開隱藏於黑暗中的真相，守護公主與夥伴，迎來真正的幸福結局？

2451700.desc: A hybrid with no memories. A planet out to kill you. A demanding sci-fi action game with fast-paced combat and die & retry mechanics. Fight. Die. Learn. Retry. Your body is a weapon. Your past, a mystery.

1796580.desc: 《Sorry We're Closed》是款奇異的劇情導向生存恐怖遊戲，講述天使與惡魔的碰撞下所引發的故事。遊戲結合了經典的固定視角探索，和街機風格的射擊玩法。蜜雪兒必須運用她的第三隻眼看穿兩個世界，找出隱藏的祕密並解開謎團。

4527880.desc: With your trusty handbook, banishing monstrosities beyond mortal comprehension is as simple as 1-2-3!! In this turn-based tactics puzzle game, you lead a team of contractor ghost busters through a series of haunted houses, each with a different set of unidentified monstrosities.

5101180.name: The World's Shortest Horror Game
5101180.desc: 按下一個按鈕。立刻後悔。這是一款幾分鐘就能玩完的迷你類比恐怖喜劇，適合實況蒐集反應，也適合包裝成一場小小的背叛送給朋友。你要做的只有一件事：按按鈕。沒有漫長的冒險，也沒有任何灌水內容。最好什麼都別告訴朋友，只說這遊戲很短，叫對方戴上耳機並分享畫面，然後坐下來欣賞反應。之後發生的任何事情，我們都不負責。它很短、很壞，也非常適合檢驗友情。請謹慎送禮，祝你們好運。強烈建議佩戴耳機。至於友情，我們概不保證。

4118750.desc: Experience American Sunset: Southwestern Sexcapades — a massive DLC packed with new routes, sizzling scenes, and branching paths. Choose between Cuckold or Alpha dynamics, explore Vegas and the swingers club, and shape Tracy and Justin’s fate in thrilling, replayable ways.

1546080.name: 永不落敗 Every Day We Fight
1546080.desc: 雖然身陷時間循環，但這支反抗軍小隊是人類的最後希望。《永不落敗》融合了即時探索、回合制戰術與 Roguelite 策略。玩家將學習新技能，尋找新武器，發展新戰術，努力對抗神秘的外星威脅。

top.text:
我很少見的給出差評，但我覺得這遊戲值得我給這個評價

雖然這款的特色就是Rogue，但實際玩起來真的太痛苦了，度過了簡單的第一章之後就是糟糕體驗的開始
每次只要戰敗一次就是全部從頭打，對，全部從頭，包含地圖上的一些小戰鬥也會全部重置
會繼承的講白點就是只有你的角色天賦樹而已
然後正式版跟體驗版的難度上差異真的非常巨大，我可不記得一顆手雷就能直接轟400收掉一個人
而且手雷要炸到敵人根本天方夜譚吧，從頭到尾沒成功過，敵人跑得跟飛的一樣，而

【不推薦】成長感幾乎為零，時間線機制反而持續打擊玩家投入
玩到第一章結束後，我的基地依舊簡陋，武器還停留在初期的幾把低階裝備，角色實力幾乎沒有任何提升。敵人卻能用手雷輕鬆秒殺我，難度與成長完全不成比例。遊戲要求玩家有「藍波等級」的一挑多能力，但卻沒有給予對應的資源與命。

資源與成長系統的致命缺陷
我幾乎逛遍城市大半區域，總共只收集到約 5、600 廢料，但一個綠色品質的部件就要 300。這樣的資源量根本杯水車薪，讓人對藍色或紫色裝備完
這遊戲體驗挺不錯的,就是有點貴

top.text:
這個Dlc可以不用買了

我玩Demo花了約五個小時完成第一章，把所有角色和幻兵都升到上限，武器和防具都是第一章能獲得最好的。結果今天發售後，預購獎勵、早鳥購買獎勵包括豪華版內容都超廢！廢到笑XDD

而豪華版也就魔導裝甲之鑰和魔人的秘傳書，有那麼一~~~點點點用，可以改變陸行鳥和飛空艇外觀。剩下那些道具遊戲中就能獲得了。然後這豪華版要價520元。真的不值得買。

除非是為了那兩個外觀，否則真心不推薦。

3905010.desc: 跟草帽一行人一起經營芭拉蒂2號店！ 從小船上揭幕的是專屬於您的海上餐廳。 收集食材開發新菜單、用室內裝飾隨心所欲裝潢店內…… 隨著提升餐廳的水準，這間店會成長得越來越充滿朝氣與活力，就連「那個角色」也有機會變成這裡的常客。 每當夥伴或常客增加，您的餐廳便會離大海上人人讚不絕口的店更邁進一步！ 「ONE PIECE」角色們大排長龍的海上餐廳，今日開業！

299950.name: GET EVEN
299950.desc: 深吸一口氣……試著去回想：一個女孩，一把椅子，一個炸彈。只要保持……冷靜。跟著聲音進入記憶深處。放鬆……尋找腦海最深處那些最黑暗的記憶。你能找到她嗎？時鍾正在滴答作響……這只是治療的一部分。

top.text:
倒敘以及插敘，雖然劇本未能令我大跌下巴，但也不失為一個合格的懸疑電影。

遊戲本身既是射擊遊戲也是步行模擬遊戲，加上 CornerGun 的新奇玩法，令整個遊戲體驗並不無聊。

聲優演技一流，甚至有令人眼前一亮的音樂。配樂中有一首挺歡快的小提琴曲，不知是原創或是取材自一首古典音樂呢。

非常希望能有更多這種專注敘事的遊戲。

劇情峰迴路轉引人入勝 
BGM以及氛圍營造相當到位 

戰鬥及解謎方面略有不足
頂多只能作為劇情中的點綴
破案大作。悬疑满分。就是容易玩的我头疼

1126750.name: 爆鑽小英雄 鑽頭樂園
1126750.desc: 2002年發售的「爆鑽小英雄　鑽頭樂園」，以更加美麗！而且更容易遊玩的姿態於STEAMⓇ登場了！ 和具備豐富個性的爆鑽工們一起，朝著稱霸主題樂園「鑽頭樂園」前進吧！

589360.desc: 化身年轻国王Evan，为自己立了个宏伟的使命，寻找建立新的国度，与一同冒险犯难的伙伴们，将国家团结起来、拯救人民逃离恶魔的魔掌。

4773930.name: 君临传奇之风起云涌
4773930.desc: 江湖将乱，风云已动！经典复古高爆国战版传奇，专为兄弟情义与热血厮杀而生！不氪金照样封神，不将就才能称王。极品装备、绝世武学全凭实力爆出，BOSS越狠，爆得越疯，捡到你手软！ 战鼓擂响，屠龙在手，兄弟们整装待发——攻沙、夺城、君临天下！

2552310.name: 莎拉的黑店
2552310.desc: 《莎拉的黑店》是一款輕松休閑的回合製策略管理遊戲。你將扮演主角「莎拉」，經營一家名為「地下城旅館」的旅館。這家旅館位於地下城入口，專門服務兩個敵對的冤家公會。拜托！沒有人會拒絕賺錢的機會吧？只要不被他們發現就行！你的目標是在一年內成功經營旅館，實現財富自由！

5359780.name: 象棋
5359780.desc: Enjoy Chinese chess in an ink-wash setting. Play against an offline opponent or a friend on the same device, learn through interactive lessons and endgame challenges, review game records, and create your own positions.

5069390.name: Hentai Tales: Humanoid Doll
5069390.desc: 多年積蓄之後，我終於帶回了入門款陪伴型機械女僕「綿綿」。 然而，一場故障打亂了我平凡的日常，並為我帶來了一份秘密補償：擁有故障連線的頂級「狂野」原型機「薇歐拉」。 我踏入機械女僕與非尋常親密關係世界的旅程，就此展開。

4815730.name: Kurdistan Simulator
4815730.desc: Kurdistan Simulator 是一款實驗性的步行模擬遊戲，背景是一個並不存在的國家的空曠大地。當你在這片只存在於某人想像中的虛無裡漫遊時，你會發現無事可做……直到你找到隱藏的驚喜。

5221020.name: Fitz's Aim Trainer
5221020.desc: An FPS aim trainer that runs natively on Mac and Windows. 30 default excercises along custom excercise creation. There is a ranked benchmark mode ranging from Mortal to Omnipotent, global leaderboards and custom excercise sharing. Made by one person who just wanted an aim trainer for Mac.

5263600.name: 101 Cats: San Francisco
5263600.desc: 加入這場冒險，在精心打造的舊金山風景中，尋找101隻小貓咪🐾的藏身之處。 🏆贏取眾多成就。你能找到多少隻呢？ 😺快來抓緊時間！ ⏱️

movies.name: TRAILER - 101 Cats in San Francisco - PLAY NOW!

5377090.name: Dealer's Choice
5377090.desc: Three roguelites at one table. Drop balls through a plinko board, roll dice for poker hands, bet against a roulette wheel you rebuild as you play — then push your luck for one more floor, one more roll, one more spin. The Dealer is watching.

5403390.name: Super Clown Save Santa
5403390.desc: 2.5d Platformer where you control Super Clown. Mission to avoid traps and enemies and enemy bee and Save Santa Claus and Save Christmas

5132600.name: Touwers: Defend the Realm
5132600.desc: Touwers is a fantasy tower defense strategy game where you place towers on a grid, hold the line through escalating enemy waves, and grow your economy to be able to unlock all kinds of perks along your way through 4 distinct campaigns.

4435490.name: 決勝時刻®：現代戰爭® 4
4435490.desc: 在《決勝時刻®：現代戰爭® 4》中，朝鮮半島爆發戰爭，北韓發動全面入侵，世界局勢瀕臨失控。

441380.name: PAC-MAN™ CHAMPIONSHIP EDITION 2
441380.desc: The much-awaited sequel to PAC-MAN™ CHAMPIONSHIP EDITION! Featuring eye-popping 3D graphics and funky visuals! New modes include Score Attack and an Adventure mode!

movies.name: PAC-MAN Championship Edition 2 - Double PAC-MAN Madness!

775500.name: 緋紅結繫
775500.desc: 此為以腦部與科技蓬勃發展的世界為舞台，可以置身體驗運用自身「念力」與夥伴們的形形色色力量戰鬥的超腦力動作，以及採用雙主角視角描寫的扎實故事劇情的「超腦力動作RPG」

331600.name: One Piece Pirate Warriors 3
331600.desc: 從佛夏村到神秘的德雷斯羅薩，如實呈現《航海王》的原版劇情。你有堅定的決心，可以打敗多佛朗明哥和其他史上最危險的海賊嗎？

movies.name: One Piece: Pirate Warriors 3 - 3 Brothers Trailer
One Piece: Pirate Warriors 3 - Dressrosa Trailer ESRB

1082430.name: Before Your Eyes
1082430.desc: 展開一段扣人心弦的第一人稱敘事冒險遊戲，你將透過實際的眨眼，操控劇情走向，並影響結局。這種創新的操作方式，將讓你完全沉浸在悲喜交加的回憶世界中，同時在你眼前閃過一生。

movies.name: BEFORE YOUR EYES - Announce Trailer TC
Before Your Eyes - The Art of Blinking TC

1163550.name: 隊長小翼 新秀崛起
1163550.desc: 「隊長小翼 新秀崛起」是以至今依然飽受世界喜愛的動畫作品「隊長小翼」為題材，加上符合現代風格的影像水準，讓所有人都能簡單施展超級球技的足球動作遊戲。

compare.en: Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions

743450.name: Monster Prom
743450.desc: You have 3 weeks to get a date for Monster Prom! Go through absurd and funny situations, raise your stats and seduce one of your classmates. Beautiful art, bold, unapologetic dialogue and hard choices make up this Multiplayer (1-4 players) Dating Sim. Be your worst self.

1140270.name: Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp
1140270.desc: "Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp" brings you more of the world's best (and maybe only?) multiplayer dating sim; but in a way you've never expected!

219740.name: 饑荒
219740.desc: Don’t Starve is an uncompromising wilderness survival game full of science and magic. Enter a strange and unexplored world full of strange creatures, dangers, and surprises. Gather resources to craft items and structures that match your survival style.

755500.name: ONE PIECE World Seeker
755500.desc: 「好了，要從哪開始冒險呢！」 登上前所未見的獨特島嶼，讓您全心享受「一個大冒險」的動作冒險遊戲登場！ 化身為魯夫，解開島上隱藏的種種謎團吧。

1859470.name: 吃豆人 吃遍世界
1859470.desc: 冒險的舞台是「幽靈之島」。為了從邪惡機器人「Toc-Man」手中拯救被綁架的PAC-MAN一家人，PAC-MAN的冒險即將啟程。

1089090.name: ONE PIECE 海賊無雙4
1089090.desc: ■海賊無雙4是進化後的『ONE PIECE』無雙遊戲！本作以「擬真的ONE PIECE戰場體驗」為核心概念，在動作場面中加入建築物的破壞及煙塵瀰漫的效果等，力求再現「ONE PIECE戰場」。此外也添加過去的「海賊無雙」中從未出現的全新要素，實現前所未有、爽快感十足的『ONE PIECE』無雙動作遊戲體驗！

848350.name: Katamari Damacy REROLL
848350.desc: 操縱王子，一邊滾動塊一邊黏住各種物體，讓塊越來越大──新鮮感翻騰的動作遊戲。

552590.name: The Sexy Brutale
552590.desc: The Sexy Brutale — a never-ending masked ball featuring intrigue, murder and the (quite possibly) occult! Relive the same mysterious day where the guests at the casino mansion are being murdered by the staff over and over again...

1062810.name: Inkbound
1062810.desc: A turn-based tactical roguelike from the creators of Monster Train. Play solo or co-op, create powerful builds, and save the Atheneum.

454650.name: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2
454650.desc: 知名的DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE推出續作──DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2。 畫面表現提升後的DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2，將帶領你進入史上最龐大、最多彩的七龍珠世界。
